programmes.d: In 1980, armed gunmen stormed the Iranian Embassy in London, England, taking everyone hostage. After 6 days, a group of highly trained SAS soldiers launched an epic raid to end the standoff.
Retired CIA interrogator Alice Racine is unexpectedly called back into action when the CIA apprehends a suspect believed to have direct knowledge of another imminent attack.
Three couples cross paths over the course of one fateful evening in a Los Angeles restaurant. Though all strangers, their stories are weaved together as they hurl toward an explosive end.
